items.name: Universal Power Adapter
items.description: A power cable is a short length of flexible cord (typically no more than 5 feet long) that can be used to attach a technological device to a power generator. It takes a move action to attach a cable to a generator or a device—thus, it takes a full round to fully connect the two together. Once connected, the item draws power from the generator rather than from its internal battery stores. items.name: Echolocators
items.description:
Active & passive sonar array is installed as part of the inner-ear construct. These function as cybernetic-ears granting +5 perception and +4 vs deafening attacks.

As a swift action, you may emit a pulse of sound that functions as echolocation. This effect is audible which can void your stealth but grants 30' echolocation until your next turn.

items.name: Datajack
items.description:
Implanted at the base of the neck, this device allows direct mental connection to any compatible device. 

If connected to a device, the wearer receives +5 on knowledge engineering checks to manipulate or diagnose that device.

items.name: Jetpack
items.description:
A jetpack consists of a pair of cylindrical tanks worn on a shoulder harness with a pair of motion-sensitive rings worn on the thumbs that are used as wireless thrust and attitude controls. The jetpack can be activated as a swift action and grants a fly speed of 60 feet with poor maneuverability. If the wearer successfully hovers near ground level, she obscures visibility as though she had the Hover feat. The exhaust isn’t hot or concentrated enough to be used as a weapon.

items.name: Commset
items.description: This handheld device allows for communication between two commset users. A commset carries audio and visual signals, and includes a built-in camera that can record all communications being broadcast. Communication between two commsets requires both users to tune their individual devices to the same frequency. items.name: Chemalyzer
items.description: A chemalyzer is a handheld unit with an extendable wand tipped with a sampling nozzle. It grants a +5 competence bonus on all Craft (alchemy) or Knowledge (engineering) checks to identify an unknown pharmaceutical, poison, chemical, or substance. It cannot aid in the identification of magical effects or items like potions.

items.name: Fire Extinguisher
items.description: This cylindrical device has a nozzle at one end and a handle on one side. When activated as a standard action, a fire extinguisher creates a 15-foot cone of misty vapor that swiftly extinguishes fires within its area of effect. Against magical fire effects, such as those created by a wall of fire or similar spell, the fire extinguisher only extinguishes the part of the larger effect its vapors directly contact. items.name: Cybernetic Eyes
items.description:
Description
A cybernetic eye can be enhanced by cyber art for no additional cost, giving it an unusual color or pattern. When a pair of eyes is installed, the user gains:

Darkvision 60'
+5 circumstance bonus on Perception checks
+4 resistance bonus on saving throws against blindness or visual effects.
